query: SELECT equipamentoTag, equipamentoDescricao, COUNT(*) as qtd, SUM(CAST(custo AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total FROM item_despesa_importado WHERE lancamentoCustoId IN (SELECT id FROM lancamento_custo WHERE contaCustoId = 7) GROUP BY equipamentoTag, equipamentoDescricao ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20
